_comment: Edit this file any time to change what the screensaver cycles through. No restart needed - it's re-read every 60s. Each objective is either a plain string, or an object {"text": "...", "image": "picture.png"} to show a picture beside the text. Image files go in static/media/ and are named here by filename only; around 800px wide is plenty.

objectives.text: Mentoring cadets in the ESCS Capstone Program, providing technical support and subject matter expertise
Developing FAIR-LLM, a Python framework designed to accelerate the development of powerful, consistent, and modular agentic AI applications
Managing and delivering compute resources to cadets and faculty to power USAFA research initatives - 6 servers with over 30 high-performance GPUs
Using FAIR-LLM to develop strict AI tutors that are designed to help cadets learn course material, rather than just giving them the correct answers
CHROME STAR: a living, evolving, Multi-Domain warfighting simulation that accelerates cadet leadership through forced, high-stakes decision-making
Assessing the future of AI and data science by testing new models, frameworks, and methodologies
